note: One flat white SVG per pact that used to share its icon with a sibling pact, written out by hand as plain path/polygon geometry (no tracing tool, no embedded bitmap, white only, 100 x 100 box like the native bond icons). Entries with shapeSource "hand-designed" were drawn without an AIGC step.

holyGun.concept: 左轮弹仓正面（枪）上悬一圈光环，两侧各三道向外展开的尖翼：带翼光环下的圣枪。
holyGun.promptSummary: No AIGC run (LiClick gateway login unavailable): four hand drafts, refined against a spec measured from the 23 native bond icons.
holyGun.selection: A winged side-view pistol, B winged barrel, C pistol inside a halo ring, D revolver cylinder with halo and feathers. D picked: heraldic and mirror-symmetric like the native icons, still reads as a gun at 24 px; A is busy at 24 px, B reads as a pillar, C is a plain badge ring.

artillery.concept: 一枚带尾翼的炮弹斜落，身后两道拖尾，砸向右下角十角炸裂的星芒。
artillery.promptSummary: No AIGC run (LiClick gateway login unavailable): four hand drafts, refined against a spec measured from the 23 native bond icons.
artillery.selection: A shell falling diagonally onto a blast, B upright shell over a crown of blast spikes, C salvo of three shells, D cannon on a wheel. A picked: diagonal like swiftShip and kazimierzShip, clearest at 24 px; B reads as a plant, C as pillars, D's wheel and barrel are too fussy.

dominator.concept: 展开的手掌（掌控）：三根尖指加左右两枚拇指，掌心一个菱形孔，下接腕环。
dominator.promptSummary: No AIGC run (LiClick gateway login unavailable): four hand drafts, refined against a spec measured from the 23 native bond icons.
dominator.selection: A open palm, B claws cradling an orb, C crown, D fist. A picked: 掌 is literally the palm, compact and symmetric; B reads as a goblet at 24 px, C is a crown (clashes with the 王冠 strategies) and too solid, D is a solid block.

breaker.concept: 四条剑臂围住中央带孔的菱形：两柄交叉的长剑，剑尖朝上，护手与剑柄朝下。
breaker.promptSummary: No AIGC run (LiClick gateway login unavailable): four hand drafts, refined against a spec measured from the 23 native bond icons.
breaker.selection: A crossed swords with fullers, B four sword arms round a diamond, C crossed curved sabres, D shield split by a gap. B picked: the diamond and the even gaps give it the native icons' cut-and-gap look; A's guards clump together, C is too thin, D carries no blade.

formSwap.concept: 菱形分成左右两半、上下错位：左半空心带实心核，右半实心带空心核，形态互换。
formSwap.promptSummary: No AIGC run (LiClick gateway login unavailable): four hand drafts, refined against a spec measured from the 23 native bond icons.
formSwap.selection: A split diamond with swapped cores, B two interlocking hooks, C bow-tie of two arrowheads, D two stacked diamonds. A picked: carries the 'two forms' idea in one silhouette with ink share 0.33 like the originals; B is a solid square (ink 0.76), C is too flat, D loses the diamond.
